title: 01 — Parallel Performance — 正式整理
markdown:
### 01 — Parallel Performance — 正式整理 #### Serial vs Parallelizable Work **Serial Work** → Must execute serially  Dependency **Parallelizable Work** → Can execute serially OR in parallel  ≠ Parallel Execution $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{Whether to parallelize depends on available cores and overhead.}}$ $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{Overhead examples: creating threads, distributing tasks, and synchronization/waiting.}}$ #### Amdahl's Law — Forward / Inverse
**Forward** 已知 $f,P$ → 求 $S$ $$ S=\frac{1}{(1-f)+\frac{f}{P}} $$
**Inverse** 已知 $S,P$ → 求 $q$ $$ q=\frac{\frac1S-\frac1P}{1-\frac1P} $$
$$ \underbrace{q+f=1}_{\text{Complementary}} $$ $$ \footnotesize q=1-f:\text{Serial Fraction};\quad f:\text{Parallelizable Fraction};\quad P:\text{Processors};\quad S:\text{Speedup} $$ #### Strong vs Weak Scaling **两种 Parallel Performance 实验方式（不是两种硬件）**
**Strong Scaling** $$ \begin{gathered} \text{Core}\ \uparrow\\[-1pt] {\scriptsize\color{gray}{\downarrow}}\\[-1pt] \text{Total Work = Fixed}\\[-1pt] {\scriptsize\color{gray}{\downarrow}}\\[-1pt] \text{Solution Time}\ \downarrow\\[4pt] \mathbf{Speedup}\ \uparrow \end{gathered} $$ $$ S_{\mathrm{strong}}=\frac{a+b}{a+\frac{b}{P}} $$
**Weak Scaling — Lab L6** $$ \begin{gathered} \text{Core}\ \uparrow\\[-1pt] {\scriptsize\color{gray}{\downarrow}}\\[-1pt] \text{Work / Core}\approx\text{Fixed}\\[-1pt] {\scriptsize\color{gray}{\downarrow}}\\[-1pt] \text{Total Work}\ \uparrow\\[4pt] \textbf{Solution Time}\approx\textbf{Fixed} \end{gathered} $$ $$ S_{\mathrm{weak}}=\frac{a+bP}{a+b} $$
$$ \footnotesize a=\text{Sequential Operations};\quad b=\text{Base Parallel Operations};\quad P=\text{Processors} $$ **Lab L6 模型**：Sequential Work 固定，Parallel Work 随 Processor 数量增加；Work per Core **近似**固定。Base Parallel Operations 表示基础规模下的可并行工作量，英文题目不一定写 Base。 #### Flynn's Taxonomy & SPMD **Flynn's Taxonomy** → Classify by Instruction Streams (IS) and Data Streams (DS)
**SISD** 1 IS + 1 DS
**SIMD** 1 IS + M DS
**MISD** M IS + 1 DS
**MIMD** M IS + M DS
$\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize 1=\text{Single};\quad M=\text{Multiple};\quad 1\ \text{IS}\neq 1\ \text{Instruction}}$ **SPMD** → Same **Program** across Threads ; Multiple Data ; Different Branches allowed $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{SPMD = Programming Model, not a fifth Flynn type. Program = sequence of Instructions.}}$ **Program → Threads → Instructions** ```svg ``` $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{SIMD: 1 vector instruction processes multiple elements; Scalar: separate instructions, one element each.}}$ $\textcolor{gray}{\footnotesize \text{ADD or SUB may use SIMD. Scalar }\neq\text{ SISD. Independent IS across cores }\rightarrow\text{ MIMD hardware.}}$
